english.title: Buggery with consent - male 16 - 20 years and male over 16 years
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) committed buggery with **(..SPECIFY NAME..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) of the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and location
committed the act of buggery

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence became OBSOLETE from 03/11/1994

(ii) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required for buggery between two males where either is under the age of twenty-one.

(iii) MOPI RETENTION: Review the offence record and retain in line with its modern equivalent. Where both parties are over 18 this is not an offence, so MoPI 4 applies. If one party was under 18, MoPI 2 offences might apply (eg: abuse of position of trust or family member).' (iv) No longer an offence/no modern equivalent. MoPI Group 2 has been allocated for manual review to ensure that any additional risk factors are captured as appropriate

other.penalty:
Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
